title: Deployment Stage Ownership Checklist (CS rollout snapshot)
body:
Purpose:
This is a lightweight, practical checklist to track milestone ownership, current status, and active blockers for inference rollouts managed by Customer Success. Designed for 15‑minute weekly syncs with engineering and customer stakeholders. Keep terse — one line per milestone; escalate only open blockers > 3 business days or affecting SLOs.

Scope:
- Applies to hosted, dedicated, and private deployments during customer onboarding, ramp, and first 90 days post-go-live.
- Focus areas: infra readiness, model validation, latency/cost tuning, security/compliance handoffs, ops runbook and playbook delivery.

How to use:
1) Paste the table below into the weekly sync note.
2) Owners update status and blocker field before the meeting.
3) Items marked ESCALATE get assigned an action and an expected resolution date.

Key contacts / escalation path:
- CS lead: Maya Chen (owner) — maya@redwood.ai
- Escalation to Eng (serving runtime): Liam O'Connor — liam@redwood.ai
- Escalation to Infra: Priya Patel — priya@redwood.ai
- Exec SPOC for enterprise: Diego Ruiz — diego@redwood.ai

Milestone tracker (single lines — sort by due date):
- Milestone: Account kickoff complete | Owner: Maya Chen | Due: 2025-10-22 | Status: Done | Blocker: None | Notes: kickoff slides + action items in CS-4723
- Milestone: Network/VPC peering validated | Owner: Priya Patel | Due: 2025-10-30 | Status: In progress | Blocker: Customer firewall rules pending | Mitigation: Temporary tunnel; security review 10/28 | Action: Priya to confirm rule exceptions
- Milestone: Model version pinned for prod | Owner: Liam O'Connor | Due: 2025-11-05 | Status: In progress | Blocker: Model quantization caused 3% dev quality regression | Mitigation: A/B two quant profiles; regression eval running | Action: Liam to post eval link
- Milestone: Dedicated pool capacity reserved | Owner: Diego Ruiz | Due: 2025-11-08 | Status: Planned | Blocker: Contract sync with finance | Mitigation: Use burst on hosted for first 2 weeks | Action: Diego/Finance to finalize PO
- Milestone: Latency SLO validation (p95) | Owner: Eng-SRE (Liam O'Connor) | Due: 2025-11-12 | Status: At risk | Blocker: Intermittent queuing under burst traffic | Mitigation: Increase batch_size cap and enable prefix cache | Action: SRE to run load sweep and report
- Milestone: RBAC and audit logging enabled | Owner: Security (Priya Patel) | Due: 2025-11-15 | Status: In review | Blocker: KMS integration test failing for daily key rotation | Mitigation: Fallback to customer-managed rotation policy; security review ongoing | Action: Priya to share test logs
- Milestone: Ops runbook handed to customer | Owner: CS Ops (Maya Chen) | Due: 2025-11-20 | Status: Planned | Blocker: None | Notes: runbook template in confluence:cs-rollouts-onboarding

Blocker triage rubric (short):
- Critical (ESCALATE): causes outages or misses contractual SLA — notify exec SPOC and Eng leadership within 2 hours.
- High: substantially degrades function (p95 latency > target or >25% cost increase) — daily owner update until cleared.
- Medium: workarounds exist; track in weekly sync.
- Low: backlog candidate; no meeting action required.

Signals for go/no-go (final decision criteria):
- All critical blockers cleared.
- Latency and throughput within agreed SLOs for 48h under expected peak traffic.
- Security checklist (RBAC, audit, KMS) completed and attested.
- Ops runbook delivered and customer runbook accepted.

Notes / common patterns seen in recent rollouts:
- Model quantization regressions are the most common time sink; plan an extra A/B evaluation slot and hold a quantization rollback build.
- Network firewall delays are often customer's slowest path — offer a temporary SSH tunnel or hosted-burst plan up front.
- Early caching config (prefix/KV) reduces token cost quickly; include a recommended baseline in the kickoff.

Quick links and artifacts:
- Jira board: JIRA:CS-4723 (implementation epics)
- Confluence template: confluence:cs-rollouts-onboarding
- Ops PR for runbook templates: github.com/redwood-inference/ops/pull/124

Next steps before weekly sync:
- Owners to paste one-line updates in this doc and flag ESCALATE where applicable.
- CS lead to update go/no-go checklist and send pre-meeting summary to customer 24h prior.

Version history:
- 2025-10-12: created by Maya Chen (initial template)
- 2026-02-28: updated blocker rubric and go/no-go signals (Priya + Liam)

Questions / open items to resolve:
- Confirm whether customer will accept hosted-burst fallback for first 30 days (Action: Account Exec)
- Decide on quantization profile naming convention to avoid confusion across Dedicated/Hosted variants (Action: Applied ML)
